resources.string: The terminal renderer stopped. Leave this screen and reopen the terminal. The remote session has not been restarted.
Output continuity was lost. Disconnect and create a new terminal session.
The terminal view is not responding. The remote connection has not been restarted.
Only the local view will be recreated. The remote shell stays open. Full-screen apps such as nano may need to redraw; their visual state cannot be guaranteed after rebuilding from history.
